messages:
Maya Growth: Quick sync 1: need to re-pivot paid spend into a short 48h burst for high-intent search + retargeting. Enrollment for the webinar is low.
Ethan Paid: I can shift budget. Proposal: pull 30% from broad match and move to exact & phrase for 'llm inference api' and 'low-latency LLM'. Also boost retargeting by 35% for 48h.
Rina Creative: I'll push two headline refreshes and a new case-study CTA. Drafts: 
- H1: Production LLMs with reliable latency
- H2: Reduce inference cost per token by 2x
CTA: Watch demo (30min) / API quickstart
Sam Analytics: Baseline: webinar reg CVR = 3.1%, CPA avg = $95. If we tighten to 14d retargeting and exclude prior registrants, we should see higher CVR. I'll create a tiny dashboard widget to monitor.
Maya Growth: Also need UTM convention: utm_campaign=may_burst&utm_medium=cpc&utm_source=google&utm_content={variant}. Use LP-webinar-v4.
Ethan Paid: Set rule: if CPA > $140 over 6h, rollback to previous allocation. Enable even creative rotation for 24h then optimize.
ads-bot: Campaign "may_burst" updated: budget reallocation +30% to exact, retargeting +35% (48h). Rule set: pause if CPA > 140 USD (6h). Change executed at 09:00 PT.
Rina Creative: Will upload assets by 08:30 PT. Including alt hero image (dashboard screenshot) and testimonial line.
Sam Analytics: I'll monitor CTR, CVR, webinar attendance rate, and trial-start within 7d. Ping here with anomalies.
Maya Growth: Great. Checkpoint 12h after launch, then final decision at 48h. Thanks team :thumbsup:
